audit_items.proof_trace: The `decryptSealedBid` function is guarded by `_verifyPrivateKeyIsPublished()` (L273-277), which reverts when `privateKey == 0`; `privateKey` is initialized to 0 and written exclusively in `publishSaleResults` (L178) which itself requires `whenRefundPeriodIsOver` and `whenCancelLocked` guards. The ECIES scheme is internally consistent: investors encrypt with `ECIES.encrypt(amountOut, PUBLIC_KEY, PRIVATE_KEY, keccak256(investor, FIXED_SALT))` and decryption at L215-220 recovers the identical shared secret `x-coord(k²·G)`; off-chain confidentiality is maintained because `fixedSalt` (the effective 256-bit secret) is only stored and emitted in `publishSaleResults`, and guessing it pre-publication is computationally infeasible.
